records.title: Your Transformer is Secretly Linear
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 The study finds near-linear relationships between selected Transformer decoder blocks and tests deleting or approximating some blocks with limited loss changes. It suggests a possible model-compute reduction, but provides no direct serving latency/throughput or memory evaluation, so it remains a borderline efficiency lead.

records.title: Dwell in the Beginning: How Language Models Embed Long Documents for Dense Retrieval
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 The paper studies positional bias in long-document dense-retrieval embeddings through T5 training stages. It finds that models weight earlier content more after contrastive pretraining/fine-tuning; its method and evaluation concern representation quality, not serving efficiency or inference-system design.
